definitions.explanation: The organ in the lower abdomen that stores urine until it is passed. Both kanji are outside the everyday kanji list, so it is often written ぼうこう in kana.

examples.japanese: {膀胱|ぼうこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{尿|にょう}→尿：33398_nyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧たまる。
⟦{冷|ひ}える→冷える：01154_hieru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{膀胱|ぼうこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{刺激|しげき}→刺激：03166_shigeki⟧⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧やすい。
examples.english: When you get cold, the bladder is easily irritated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{尿道|にょうどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{膀胱炎|ぼうこうえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧やすい⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Women are said to get cystitis more easily than men because their urethra is shorter.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {膀胱炎|ぼうこうえん}: cystitis, a bladder infection
- {膀胱|ぼうこう}がん: bladder cancer
- {過活動膀胱|かかつどうぼうこう}: overactive bladder

WATCH OUT:
⟦{暴行|ぼうこう}→暴行：27862_boukou⟧ (assault, violence) has the same reading, and it is the word more often heard in the news.
